title: Law to boost mental health support in middle and high schools
summary: This bill would require the Department of Health and Mental Hygiene, working with the Department of Education, to place mental health coordinators in every middle and high school, prioritizing schools with higher need such as elevated violence, absenteeism or limited services. It also requires a multilingual mental health resource guide for students and families, annual reporting on school-based mental health clinics, and expanded mental health first aid training for school staff. The law would take effect 180 days after enactment.
